# Moneta (Conatus) - v2.1.1

> Release preparation: final verification of PoC updates, review deferral, fresh
> installation and upgrade from 2.1.0 is still required before publication.

LibreBugBounty 2.1.1 improves the daily research loop: recover an interactive
dialog capture, keep the reproducible PoC current, park cases that cannot be
checked today, and see your intake progress without opening the statistics page.

## Highlights

- **Recover dialog evidence:** arm capture for the next native dialog, retry a
  failed capture, or explicitly dismiss the held dialog and continue in the same
  interactive Chromium. The previous preview stays available until a new capture
  succeeds. Saving binds the image you confirmed, including through persistence
  retries; a newer dialog cannot silently replace it.
- **Update the active PoC:** adopt a changed URL from interactive review for the
  GET case's PoC and future checks, on its existing hostname. When several
  observed URLs could be relevant, choose explicitly instead of guessing. The
  original import URL, URL history and immutable screenshot source remain
  available separately.
- **Defer review with a reason:** take temporarily uncheckable cases out of the
  normal review loop without marking them fixed. An optional due date requests
  one automatic retest. Only a matching native dialog with a saved image and no
  HTTP failure returns the case to Review. A renewed checking problem leaves it
  deferred; an interrupted attempt is not automatically repeated. Repeated skips
  offer a dismissible deferral suggestion, while Enter keeps its skip behavior.
- **Compact intake progress:** session/today/time-window counts, milestones,
  pace and elapsed session time can collapse to one line. Sessions split after
  30 minutes without intake and can be ended or continued. The recent list shows
  its actual count, up to 50; clear **Current session only** for global history.
  Failed or unconfirmed submissions remain in that same list for recovery.
- **Help and follow-up:** **?** beside **Add URL** explains the configured marker,
  duplicate handling and recheck intervals. Inventory's **Workbasket** orders
  existing reminders by due date and keeps their filters through export.
- **Clearer status and updates:** interactive worker/gateway reachability is
  separate from session availability. About shows cached stable-release checks,
  a release link and exact-tag upgrade guidance. Checks never install updates.

## Reliability fixes

- A replaced dialog image requires renewed confirmation before saving.
- A failed native-dialog capture and takeover cannot release an old queued key
  into the new controller's session.
- Browser intake waits for concurrent SQLite writers before reading in its
  transaction, avoiding an immediate lock-upgrade failure.
- Confirmed new entries survive a temporary history outage and page reload;
  recovery reconciles them without duplicate or resurrected rows.
- Fresh worker startup preserves writable PHP cache directories. The recheck
  runtime also provides a private display for scheduled native-dialog recovery.

## Upgrade from 2.1.0

1. Create and verify a [database and artifact backup](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.1.1/BACKUP.md).
   Save or end active interactive work, then stop DDEV and its workers.
2. Update the checkout to **v2.1.1**, retaining your custom storage paths and
   local configuration. Follow the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/tfgrass/librebugbounty/blob/v2.1.1/README.md#upgrade-an-existing-workspace)
   to refresh generated worker dependencies while the application is stopped.
3. Run `ddev start`. Startup installs the locked dependencies and applies the
   additive migrations for intake sessions (`Version20261018000000`), active
   PoC history (`Version20261018010000`) and review deferral
   (`Version20261018020000`). Existing import URLs and evidence sources are retained.
4. Customized deployments must migrate the database and restart PHP and the
   Playwright workers together. The interactive-save contract requires the
   explicitly confirmed image selection; mixing old workers or browser scripts
   with the new application is unsupported.
5. Reload open browser pages. Open **System status**, check the existing case and
   evidence inventory, and try interactive save and deferred review on an
   authorized case before relying on them.

No database reset is required. For rollback, restore the matching pre-upgrade
database and artifact snapshot into a separate recovery directory with the
earlier application version. Do not point older code at an upgraded database.

## Operating boundaries

Interactive review remains a fresh, local retry context with an absolute
20-minute lifetime. CAPTCHA handling is manual; successful clearance is not
guaranteed. An observed URL or saved image does not establish a vulnerability or
change the manual assessment. A selected PoC URL and an image's source can differ;
the retained image does not prove the selected URL was independently reproduced.
Case/domain restrictions still apply to manual work and scheduled checks.

The update checker uses only the project's public GitHub release metadata and
sends no workspace data. It does not run Git or install a release. The application
remains intended for a trusted local, single-user workspace.

## Verification scope

Publication requires the full PHP and worker/gateway suites, dependency audits,
backup tests, isolated Studio/noVNC browser acceptance, a fresh installation and
an upgrade from 2.1.0 on the exact release commit. Synthetic local Chromium
dialog tests establish the recovery mechanism, not universal Cloudflare/CAPTCHA
compatibility or coverage of every production outage.
